text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The eve of the Victoria Mile――

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Neeeee...rvouuusss...

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
I am crying now, and you? I'm fine too, 
thank you...

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Geez... Are you getting nervous again? 
Just when you finally got your energy 
back, too.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"I mean... what do you call this again? A 
flashback?"

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
The bi~tter memories of coming in 14th at 
the Oka Sho~... The view from the very 
back row of the Winning Live~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
*sob* *hic*... Pandora-chan is so 
pitiable! I don't... I don't wanna race 
anymore~~!!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"...Oh, does that mean you won't be able 
to come cheer for me at tomorrow's race 
either?"

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... I kind of don't like it. Even just 
watching it...

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
What a shame. And here I reaaaally wanted 
you to cheer for me tomorrow.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Your cheers are just bursting with 
energy, and they give me sooooo much 
strength! They're totally awesome!"

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: “...Oh yeah? Hmph...”

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"Oh yeah, Ku-chan-senpai is running in it 
too, right? ...Well, I guess I could at 
least go watch..."

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
It's settled! Then you won't mind if I 
take you into custody!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
—Anyway, we have a guest today, so please 
treat them well!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Uuugh... Feelin' nervous...

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"It's okay! Because from here on— you're 
going to watch our race."

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Pandora, keep your eyes peeled! All you 
need to do is keep your eyes open.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Enjoy loafing around while you still can, 
okay? Once today's race is over—

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
I'll make sure you can never say you're 
done with racing ever again!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Well then, I'm off! Trainer, I'll leave 
the rest to you.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
I'll make it fun for you today, too! Mwah! 
♪

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
...Are you guys always like this? Whoa. So 
intense~
choice_data_list:
Enough with the weird talk, let's get 
going too.

Enough with the weird talk, let's get 
going too.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Ngaaah... 'kay.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
—I mean, I've already raced in GⅠs, right? 
I really thought... nothing would get me 
nervous anymore.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: But...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (W A A A A H !)

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
"Go get 'em, everyoneee!" "This is where 
the racing world's heat is right now, 
isn't it?!" "Who's gonna win today?!" 
"Oooooooh!"

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
N... no way?! Wh-What is this 
intensity...?!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Everyone's got that fierce glint in their 
eyes... I-It's totally different from when 
we were running...!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
During the Oka Sho... it felt a bit more 
like they were expecting something... 
Like, 'What's gonna happen next?' kind of 
vibes...?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Still, right now... all I feel is heat! 
Excitement!? It's amazing, but...!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Trust...?
choice_data_list:
Faith that they'll definitely put on an 
incredible race.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"...Heart-chan is fighting in an 
unbelievable place—"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Incredible! Today's heat is on a whole 
other level...!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Don't you think that proves... we totally 
blew them away?"

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Everyone already knows the Tiara 
route is amazing too...!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Today's excitement definitely won't lose 
to the recent Tenno Sho (Spring), that's 
for sure!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, far from losing! I'll surpass you 
in no time!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
No one can resist the fire of our youth— 
even our nervous juniors can't help but 
dream of the Tiara♪

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
...You're right. If it burns hot and 
bright—the flame will spread.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Today, in this place... I will throw 
everything I've built up into this!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Fufu... Okay! Are you ready?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Right now, this is the front line! Let us 
show them the Tiara's best race!
